"""Finalize original C129731 sight packets without assigning a legal verdict.

The source-shaped CPU tests exercise this entrypoint with generated packets.
Only a separately reviewed original Native acquisition may support delivery.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from sight_measurement import ASSIGNMENT, measure

INPUTS = ("inventory.json", "frame_map.json", "ego_motion.json",
          "sight_rays.json", "road_geometry.json")


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def _recording_evidence(attempt: Path, report: dict, core_supplied: bool) -> list[dict]:
    """Write derived channel views while retaining the sealed source packets."""
    frame_map = json.loads((attempt / "frame_map.json").read_text())["frames"]
    motion = json.loads((attempt / "ego_motion.json").read_text())["samples"]
    rays = json.loads((attempt / "sight_rays.json").read_text())["samples"]
    if len(frame_map) != len(motion) or len(frame_map) != 900:
        raise ValueError("Original recording frame stream incomplete")
    grouped = {}
    for ray in rays:
        grouped.setdefault(ray["frame"], []).append(ray)
    times = {row["frame"]: row["time_s"] for row in frame_map}
    channels = {
        "ego_motion": [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row}
                       for row in motion],
        "sight_rays": [{"time_s": times[number], "value": grouped[number]}
                       for number in sorted(grouped)],
        "frame_join": [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row}
                       for row in frame_map],
        "original_camera_index": [
            {"time_s": row["time_s"],
             "value": {"video_frame": index, "native_frame": row["frame"],
                       "source_videos_verified": core_supplied}}
            for index, row in enumerate(frame_map)],
    }
    if not all(channels.values()):
        raise ValueError("Original recording channel missing")
    folder = attempt / "channels"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence = []
    for name, rows in channels.items():
        destination = folder / (name + ".jsonl")
        if destination.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite derived recording channel")
        destination.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":"),
                                          allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in rows))
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": "source record",
                         "reference": str(destination.relative_to(attempt))})
    contexts = {
        "road_geometry": json.loads((attempt / "road_geometry.json").read_text()),
        "case_setup": {"selected_case_id": report["case_id"],
                       "source_inventory_sha256": _sha(attempt / "inventory.json")},
    }
    for name, value in contexts.items():
        destination = folder / (name + ".json")
        if destination.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite derived recording context")
        destination.write_text(json.dumps({name: value}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": "source record",
                         "reference": str(destination.relative_to(attempt))})
    return evidence


def _check_core_alignment(attempt: Path) -> bool:
    """Join any supplied Core timeline to every original sight frame and time."""
    mapping_path = attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"
    trace_path = attempt / "trace.jsonl"
    if not mapping_path.exists() and not trace_path.exists():
        return False
    if not mapping_path.is_file() or not trace_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Core trace and video frame map must be supplied together")
    sight = json.loads((attempt / "frame_map.json").read_text())["frames"]
    mapping = _jsonl(mapping_path)
    trace = _jsonl(trace_path)
    if not (len(sight) == len(mapping) == len(trace) == 900):
        raise ValueError("Core and sight frame counts differ")
    for index, (original, frame, motion) in enumerate(zip(sight, mapping, trace)):
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or
                frame.get("carla_frame") != original["frame"] or
                frame.get("time_s") != original["time_s"] or
                motion.get("frame") != original["frame"] or
                motion.get("time_s") != original["time_s"]):
            raise ValueError("Core and sight frame identity differs")
    return True


def measure_original_sight(attempt: Path, case_id: str) -> dict:
    """Measure observed reversal and two-direction rays from sealed packets."""
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    for name in INPUTS:
        if not (attempt / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    inventory = json.loads((attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__"):
        raise ValueError("Wrong selected reversal identity")
    for atom in ("frame_map", "ego_motion", "sight_rays", "road_geometry"):
        entry = inventory.get("sources", {}).get(atom, {})
        if entry.get("path") != atom + ".json":
            raise ValueError("Original packet path differs: " + atom)
    measured = measure(attempt, inventory, case_id)
    sources = {name: _sha(attempt / name) for name in INPUTS}
    values = {
        "heading_change_deg": measured["measured_heading_change_deg"],
        "turn_frame_count": measured["turn_frames"],
        "location_kind": measured["location_kind"],
        "opposing_blocked_ray_count": measured["blocked_ray_counts"]["ahead_opposing"],
        "following_blocked_ray_count": measured["blocked_ray_counts"]["behind_same_direction"],
        "two_direction_ray_count": measured["rays_checked"],
    }
    scope = ("diagnostic software fixture only; no Native or legal acceptance"
             if inventory.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True else
             "source-bound original sight measurement; legal judgment unresolved")
    return {"format": "c129731-selected-analysis-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "scope": scope,
            "analysis_complete": True, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
            "limitations": ["A diagnostic fixture proves software wiring only",
                            "Original media and physical completion need independent review",
                            "Statutory driver visibility remains unresolved"],
            "measurements": {key: {"value": value,
                                   "method": "measure_original_sight",
                                   "sources": sources}
                             for key, value in values.items()},
            "original_sight": measured}


def build_canonical_result(attempt: Path, report: dict) -> dict:
    """Build the Native result shape; physical completion uses saved evidence."""
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result

    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("selected_case_id") != report["case_id"] or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-407" or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C129731" or
            config.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("Exact canonical reversal configuration changed")
    core_supplied = _check_core_alignment(attempt)
    if core_supplied:
        from native_camera_audit import audit as audit_native_cameras
        camera_audit = audit_native_cameras(attempt)
        if camera_audit.get("case_id") != report["case_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Original camera case differs from selected sight case")
        report["original_camera_audit"] = camera_audit
    values = report["measurements"]
    heading = values["heading_change_deg"]["value"]
    sources = values["heading_change_deg"]["sources"]
    checks = [{"target": "observed opposite-direction turn",
               "requested": True, "measured": heading >= 150,
               "method": "original frame-joined subject heading change",
               "tolerance": "150 degrees engineering observation minimum",
               "matched": heading >= 150, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
               "cause_evidence": sources}]
    suffix = config["selected_case_id"].removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if suffix != "distance_reference":
        probe = attempt / "approach_motion.json"
        if not probe.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: approach_motion.json")
        inventory = json.loads((attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
        reference = inventory.get("approach_probe", {})
        if (reference.get("path") != probe.name or
                reference.get("sha256") != _sha(probe)):
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe hash differs")
        packet = json.loads(probe.read_text())
        if packet.get("case_id") != report["case_id"] or packet.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe identity changed")
        target_ft = config["target_first_turn_distance_ft"]
        measured_m = packet.get("first_turn_distance_m")
        if (packet.get("probe_target_ft") != target_ft or
                type(measured_m) not in (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe target changed")
        target_m = target_ft * .3048
        matched = abs(measured_m - target_m) <= .1
        checks.append({"target": "first reversal approach distance",
                       "requested": target_m, "measured": measured_m,
                       "method": "original frame-joined vehicle positions",
                       "tolerance": .1, "matched": matched,
                       "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                       "cause_evidence": {"approach_motion.json": _sha(probe)}})
    description = construction["recording_description"]
    if not isinstance(description.get("channels"), list) or len(description["channels"]) != 4:
        raise ValueError("Four declared Native recording channels required")
    evidence = _recording_evidence(attempt, report, core_supplied)
    result = {"case_id": report["case_id"],
              "measured_values": {key: item["value"] for key, item in values.items()},
              "target_checks": checks, "setup_confirmed": False,
              "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved original evidence assessment pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in
                                   ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": description,
              "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {}}
    result = physical_result(attempt, result)
    validate_result(result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--finalize", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite analysis output")
    case = args.case
    if case is None:
        case = json.loads((args.attempt / "config.json").read_text())["selected_case_id"]
    report = measure_original_sight(args.attempt, case)
    if args.finalize or (args.attempt / "construction.json").is_file():
        result_path = args.attempt / "result.json"
        if result_path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite canonical result")
        result = build_canonical_result(args.attempt, report)
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        report["physical_checks"] = result["physical_checks"]
        report["realized_observables"] = result["realized_observables"]
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""CARLA-facing adapter for the original two-direction sight capture.

The caller supplies a reviewed site packet and live actors. This module reads
the loaded OpenDRIVE map, snapshots, actor transforms and CARLA ray hits. The
reviewed station locations are route measurements, never inferred from a fake
straight-line 500-foot radius. Ray clearance is an engineering observation,
not a conclusion about what a driver could see.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
import json
import math
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from sight_measurement import DIRECTIONS, STATIONS_M
from reversal_phase import HeadingReversalPhase
from reversal_route_controller import RouteFollower


def _xyz(location):
    return {axis: float(getattr(location, axis)) for axis in ("x", "y", "z")}


def load_reviewed_site(path: Path, source_sha256: str) -> dict:
    """Open the immutable site packet by its independently reviewed digest."""
    if (not isinstance(source_sha256, str) or len(source_sha256) != 64 or
            any(ch not in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in source_sha256)):
        raise ValueError("reviewed site SHA-256 required")
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != source_sha256:
        raise ValueError("reviewed site source hash mismatch")
    site = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(site, dict):
        raise ValueError("reviewed site packet must be an object")
    return site


class CarlaSightAdapter:
    @classmethod
    def from_reviewed_source(cls, world, ego, approach, site_path: Path,
                             site_sha256: str, location_factory, turn_active,
                             before_tick=None):
        return cls(world, ego, approach,
                   load_reviewed_site(site_path, site_sha256),
                   location_factory, turn_active, before_tick)

    def __init__(self, world, ego, approach, reviewed_site: dict,
                 location_factory, turn_active, before_tick=None):
        self.world, self.ego_actor, self.approach_actor = world, ego, approach
        self.site = reviewed_site
        self.location_factory = location_factory
        self.turn_active = turn_active
        self.before_tick = before_tick
        settings = world.get_settings()
        if (settings.synchronous_mode is not True or
                abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - 0.05) > 1e-8):
            raise ValueError("original Native world requires synchronous 20 Hz")
        world_map = world.get_map()
        source = world_map.to_opendrive().encode("utf-8")
        self.loaded_digest = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
        expected = reviewed_site.get("map_source_sha256")
        if expected != self.loaded_digest:
            raise ValueError("loaded OpenDRIVE map differs from reviewed source")
        for role, actor in (("ego", ego), ("approach", approach)):
            expected_id = reviewed_site.get(role + "_vehicle_id")
            expected_blueprint = reviewed_site.get(role + "_blueprint_id")
            if expected_id is not None:
                if str(actor.id) != str(expected_id):
                    raise ValueError("live actor identity differs from reviewed site")
            elif (not isinstance(expected_blueprint, str) or
                  getattr(actor, "type_id", None) != expected_blueprint):
                raise ValueError("live actor blueprint differs from reviewed site")
        if reviewed_site.get("location_kind") not in ("curve", "approach_to_crest", "near_crest"):
            raise ValueError("reviewed curve or crest classification required")
        stations = reviewed_site.get("observer_stations")
        if not isinstance(stations, list):
            raise ValueError("reviewed observer stations required")
        self.stations = {}
        for row in stations:
            key = (row.get("direction"), row.get("station_distance_m"))
            xyz = row.get("location")
            if (key in self.stations or not isinstance(xyz, dict) or
                    not row.get("road_waypoint_source") or
                    type(row.get("road_id")) is not int or
                    type(row.get("lane_id")) is not int or
                    any(type(xyz.get(axis)) not in (int, float) or
                        not math.isfinite(xyz[axis]) for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))):
                raise ValueError("reviewed observer station is incomplete or repeated")
            location = location_factory(xyz["x"], xyz["y"], xyz["z"])
            waypoint = world_map.get_waypoint(location, project_to_road=False)
            if (waypoint is None or waypoint.road_id != row["road_id"] or
                    waypoint.lane_id != row["lane_id"] or
                    math.dist(tuple(_xyz(waypoint.transform.location).values()),
                              tuple(xyz[axis] for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))) > 0.5):
                raise ValueError("reviewed observer station differs from loaded road lane")
            self.stations[key] = row
        if set(self.stations) != {(direction, distance)
                                 for direction in DIRECTIONS for distance in STATIONS_M}:
            raise ValueError("both directions need every reviewed station")
        if not reviewed_site.get("highway_source"):
            raise ValueError("reviewed highway source required")
        terrain_labels = reviewed_site.get("terrain_hit_labels")
        if (not isinstance(terrain_labels, list) or not terrain_labels or
                any(not isinstance(label, str) or not label for label in terrain_labels)):
            raise ValueError("reviewed terrain hit labels required")
        self.terrain_labels = set(terrain_labels)
        target_labels = reviewed_site.get("subject_body_hit_labels")
        if (not isinstance(target_labels, list) or not target_labels or
                any(not isinstance(label, str) or not label for label in target_labels)):
            raise ValueError("reviewed subject body hit labels required")
        self.target_labels = set(target_labels)

    def geometry(self):
        return {"source_kind": "original_native_geometry",
                "map_source_sha256": self.site["map_source_sha256"],
                "loaded_map_sha256": self.loaded_digest,
                "highway_source": self.site["highway_source"],
                "location_kind": self.site["location_kind"],
                "ego_vehicle_id": str(self.ego_actor.id),
                "approach_vehicle_id": str(self.approach_actor.id)}

    def tick(self):
        if self.before_tick is not None:
            self.before_tick()
        frame = self.world.tick()
        snapshot = self.world.get_snapshot()
        if snapshot.frame != frame:
            raise ValueError("CARLA tick and snapshot frame mismatch")
        return {"source_kind": "original_native", "frame": frame,
                "time_s": float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)}

    def ego(self, frame):
        transform = self.ego_actor.get_transform()
        active = self.turn_active(frame["frame"], self.ego_actor)
        if type(active) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("original controller turn phase must be boolean")
        return {"source_kind": "original_native", "vehicle_id": str(self.ego_actor.id),
                "yaw_deg": float(transform.rotation.yaw), "turn_active": active}

    def approach(self, frame):
        return {"source_kind": "original_native", "frame": frame["frame"],
                "time_s": frame["time_s"], "vehicle_id": str(self.approach_actor.id),
                "ego_position": _xyz(self.ego_actor.get_transform().location),
                "approach_position": _xyz(self.approach_actor.get_transform().location)}

    def ray(self, frame, direction, station_m):
        row = self.stations.get((direction, station_m))
        if row is None:
            raise ValueError("unreviewed observer station")
        xyz = row["location"]
        start = self.location_factory(xyz["x"], xyz["y"], xyz["z"] + 1.4)
        vertices = self.ego_actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(self.ego_actor.get_transform())
        if len(vertices) != 8:
            raise ValueError("original subject body needs eight Native vertices")
        center = self.ego_actor.get_transform().location
        bounds = {axis: (min(getattr(v, axis) for v in vertices) - 0.2,
                         max(getattr(v, axis) for v in vertices) + 0.2)
                  for axis in ("x", "y", "z")}
        blocked, clear = [], []
        for point in [*vertices, center]:
            hits = self.world.cast_ray(start, point)
            if not isinstance(hits, (list, tuple)):
                raise ValueError("original Native ray hits required")
            distance = math.dist(tuple(_xyz(start).values()), tuple(_xyz(point).values()))
            nearby = []
            for hit in hits:
                hit_location = hit.location
                hit_distance = math.dist(tuple(_xyz(start).values()),
                                         tuple(_xyz(hit_location).values()))
                if hit_distance < distance - 0.05:
                    nearby.append((hit_distance, hit))
            if nearby:
                _, first = min(nearby, key=lambda item: item[0])
                hit_xyz = _xyz(first.location)
                if (str(first.label) in self.target_labels and
                        all(bounds[axis][0] <= hit_xyz[axis] <= bounds[axis][1]
                            for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))):
                    clear.append(True)
                    continue
                if str(first.label) not in self.terrain_labels:
                    raise ValueError("ray occluder is outside reviewed terrain labels")
                blocked.append(f"{first.label}:{hit_xyz['x']:.3f},{hit_xyz['y']:.3f},{hit_xyz['z']:.3f}")
                clear.append(False)
            else:
                clear.append(True)
        return {"source_kind": "original_native", "frame": frame["frame"],
                "time_s": frame["time_s"], "direction": direction,
                "station_distance_m": station_m, "observer_height_m": 1.4,
                "observer_lane_source": row["road_waypoint_source"],
                "target_vehicle_id": str(self.ego_actor.id), "body_point_clear": clear,
                "terrain_hit_id": blocked[0] if not any(clear) else None}


def capture_original_carla(world, ego, approach, site_path: Path,
                           site_sha256: str, location_factory, case_id: str,
                           destination: Path, recording_id: str | None = None,
                           control_factory=None, camera_factory=None):
    """Acquire one attempt from live actors after the caller starts control.

    The caller owns the CARLA world lease and vehicle actors. Four reviewed
    cameras are acquired and cleaned up here. Supplying control_factory follows
    the reviewed case routes before
    each tick. A recorded turn phase comes from live heading;
    the saved capture independently rejects a missing 150-degree reversal.
    """
    from native_sight_capture import capture
    from native_sight_cameras import NativeSightCameras

    configured = os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT")
    if not configured:
        raise ValueError("pipeline output root required for original Native capture")
    safe_root = Path(configured).resolve()
    if not Path(destination).resolve().is_relative_to(safe_root):
        raise ValueError("original Native attempt must be under pipeline output root")
    safe_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    site = load_reviewed_site(site_path, site_sha256)
    before_tick = None
    if control_factory is not None:
        setup = site.get("case_setups", {}).get(case_id)
        if not isinstance(setup, dict):
            raise ValueError("reviewed exact case routes required")
        route_ego = RouteFollower(world.get_map(), setup.get("ego_route", {}),
                                  location_factory, control_factory)
        route_approach = RouteFollower(world.get_map(), setup.get("approach_route", {}),
                                       location_factory, control_factory)

        def before_tick():
            route_ego.apply(ego)
            route_approach.apply(approach)

    adapter = CarlaSightAdapter(world, ego, approach, site, location_factory,
                                HeadingReversalPhase(), before_tick)
    if camera_factory is None:
        import carla
        camera_factory = NativeSightCameras
    else:
        carla = None
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="c129731-cameras-", dir=safe_root) as tmp:
        cameras = camera_factory(world, site, Path(tmp), carla)
        try:
            return capture(adapter, case_id, destination, recording_id=recording_id,
                           camera_recorder=cameras)
        finally:
            cameras.close()

"""Independently verify four original, frame-joined camera sources."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from native_sight_cameras import SPECS


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def audit(attempt: Path, expected_frames: int = 900) -> dict:
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    inventory = json.loads((attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
    sources = inventory.get("camera_sources")
    if not isinstance(sources, dict) or set(sources) != {name for name, _, _ in SPECS}:
        raise ValueError("exact four original camera sources required")
    if type(expected_frames) is not int or expected_frames < 1:
        raise ValueError("positive expected frame count required")
    frame_source = inventory.get("sources", {}).get("frame_map")
    if not isinstance(frame_source, dict) or frame_source.get("path") != "frame_map.json":
        raise ValueError("sealed original frame map required")
    frame_path = (attempt / frame_source["path"]).resolve()
    if not frame_path.is_relative_to(attempt) or not frame_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("original frame map missing")
    frame_hash = _sha(frame_path)
    if frame_hash != frame_source.get("sha256"):
        raise ValueError("original frame map hash changed")
    frames = json.loads(frame_path.read_text()).get("frames")
    if not isinstance(frames, list) or len(frames) != expected_frames:
        raise ValueError("original frame map count mismatch")
    for index, row in enumerate(frames):
        if (not isinstance(row, dict) or type(row.get("frame")) is not int or
                type(row.get("time_s")) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isfinite(row["time_s"])):
            raise ValueError("original frame map identity missing")
        if index and (row["frame"] != frames[index - 1]["frame"] + 1 or
                      not 0.045 <= row["time_s"] - frames[index - 1]["time_s"] <= 0.055):
            raise ValueError("original frame map is not contiguous at 20 Hz")
    output = {}
    for name, width, height in SPECS:
        entry = sources[name]

                entry.get("source_kind") != "original_native"):
            raise ValueError("original camera source binding missing: " + name)
        video = (attempt / entry["path"]).resolve()
        if not video.is_relative_to(attempt) or not video.is_file():
            raise ValueError("original camera video missing: " + name)
        digest = _sha(video)
        if digest != entry.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("original camera video hash changed: " + name)
        probe = subprocess.run(
            ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-count_frames",
             "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,nb_read_frames,r_frame_rate,width,height",
             "-of", "json", str(video)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        if probe.returncode:
            raise ValueError("original camera ffprobe failed: " + name)
        streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams", [])
        if (len(streams) != 1 or streams[0].get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or
                streams[0].get("nb_read_frames") != str(expected_frames) or
                streams[0].get("r_frame_rate") != "20/1" or
                streams[0].get("width") != width or streams[0].get("height") != height):
            raise ValueError("original camera capture profile failed: " + name)
        decoded = subprocess.run(
            ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-xerror", "-i", str(video),
             "-f", "null", "-"], capture_output=True, check=False)
        if decoded.returncode:
            raise ValueError("original camera full decode failed: " + name)
        output[name] = {"sha256": digest, "frames": expected_frames,
                        "width": width, "height": height, "fps": 20,
                        "full_decode_passed": True}
    return {"format": "c129731-native-four-view-audit-v1",

"""Spawn one planned reversal case from an immutable reviewed Native site.

This is a portable CARLA-facing constructor. It needs a reviewed OpenDRIVE map,
route stations, blueprint IDs and exact spawn transforms. It does not invent
those source facts or start the reversal controller/cameras.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
from pathlib import Path

from carla_sight_adapter import load_reviewed_site
from sight_measurement import ASSIGNMENT


DISTANCE_TARGETS_FT = {
    "distance_reference": 500,
    "distance_below_500ft": 499,
    "distance_at_500ft": 500,
    "distance_above_500ft": 501,
}


def _spawn_transform(row: dict, transform_factory):
    xyz = row.get("location")
    yaw = row.get("yaw_deg")
    if (not isinstance(xyz, dict) or
            any(type(xyz.get(axis)) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isfinite(xyz[axis]) for axis in ("x", "y", "z")) or
            type(yaw) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(yaw) or
            type(row.get("road_id")) is not int or
            type(row.get("lane_id")) is not int):
        raise ValueError("reviewed spawn transform and road lane required")
    return transform_factory(xyz["x"], xyz["y"], xyz["z"], yaw)


def construct_case(world, blueprint_library, site_path: Path,
                   site_sha256: str, case_id: str, transform_factory):
    """Return two live actors; caller owns their eventual destruction."""
    suffix = case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") or suffix not in DISTANCE_TARGETS_FT:
        raise ValueError("unsupported exact reversal case")
    site = load_reviewed_site(site_path, site_sha256)
    loaded_digest = hashlib.sha256(world.get_map().to_opendrive().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    if loaded_digest != site.get("map_source_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("loaded map differs from reviewed case site")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    if settings.synchronous_mode is not True or abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - 0.05) > 1e-8:
        raise ValueError("Native construction requires synchronous 20 Hz world")
    setup = site.get("case_setups", {}).get(case_id)
    if not isinstance(setup, dict) or setup.get("target_first_turn_distance_ft") != DISTANCE_TARGETS_FT[suffix]:
        raise ValueError("reviewed exact distance case setup missing")
    actor_rows = [setup.get("ego_spawn"), setup.get("approach_spawn")]
    if any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in actor_rows):
        raise ValueError("both reviewed actor spawns required")
    world_map = world.get_map()
    transforms = []
    for row in actor_rows:
        transform = _spawn_transform(row, transform_factory)
        waypoint = world_map.get_waypoint(transform.location, project_to_road=False)
        if (waypoint is None or waypoint.road_id != row["road_id"] or
                waypoint.lane_id != row["lane_id"]):
            raise ValueError("actor spawn differs from reviewed road lane")
        transforms.append(transform)
    blueprint_ids = [site.get("ego_blueprint_id"), site.get("approach_blueprint_id")]
    if any(not isinstance(bp, str) or not bp.startswith("vehicle.") for bp in blueprint_ids):
        raise ValueError("reviewed vehicle blueprints required")
    blueprints = [blueprint_library.find(bp) for bp in blueprint_ids]
    actors = []
    try:
        for blueprint, transform, expected_type in zip(blueprints, transforms, blueprint_ids):
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, transform)
            if actor is None:
                raise ValueError("reviewed actor spawn failed")
            actors.append(actor)
            if actor.type_id != expected_type:
                raise ValueError("spawned actor blueprint differs from reviewed site")
        if actors[0].id == actors[1].id:
            raise ValueError("subject and approach actor identities collided")
        return tuple(actors)
    except Exception:
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        raise

"""Acquire source-bound Native sight packets for the saved NRS 484B.407 audit.

The adapter supplies observed engine state; this module does not synthesize
terrain, road classification, vehicle motion, or visibility judgments.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from sight_measurement import ASSIGNMENT, DIRECTIONS, STATIONS_M, measure


def _require_native(packet: dict, label: str) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(packet, dict) or packet.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
        raise ValueError(f"{label} lacks original Native provenance")
    return packet


def _file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def capture(adapter, case_id: str, destination: Path, frame_count: int = 900,
            recording_id: str | None = None, camera_recorder=None) -> dict:
    """Collect 20 Hz frame, motion and turn-ray records from a Native adapter.

    Adapter methods: geometry(), tick(), ego(frame), ray(frame, direction,
    station_m). Each must return observed packets with source_kind. Geometry
    also binds the loaded road map digest to its reviewed source digest.
    """
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") or type(frame_count) is not int or frame_count < 900:
        raise ValueError("exact case and at least 900 frames required")
    destination = Path(destination)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite sight attempt")
    geometry = adapter.geometry()
    if not isinstance(geometry, dict) or geometry.get("source_kind") != "original_native_geometry":
        raise ValueError("original Native road geometry required")
    expected = geometry.get("map_source_sha256")
    if not isinstance(expected, str) or len(expected) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in expected):
        raise ValueError("reviewed map source digest required")
    if geometry.get("loaded_map_sha256") != expected:
        raise ValueError("loaded map differs from reviewed source")
    if not geometry.get("ego_vehicle_id") or not geometry.get("highway_source"):
        raise ValueError("road and subject vehicle source required")
    probe_targets_ft = {"distance_below_500ft": 499,
                        "distance_at_500ft": 500,
                        "distance_above_500ft": 501}
    probe_target = probe_targets_ft.get(case_id.removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__"))
    if probe_target is not None and not geometry.get("approach_vehicle_id"):
        raise ValueError("distance probe needs original approaching vehicle identity")
    frames, motion, rays, approach = [], [], [], []
    for _ in range(frame_count):
        frame = _require_native(adapter.tick(), "frame")
        frame_row = {"frame": frame.get("frame"), "time_s": frame.get("time_s")}
        frames.append(frame_row)
        if camera_recorder is not None:
            camera_recorder.append(frame_row["frame"])
        ego = _require_native(adapter.ego(frame), "ego motion")
        if ego.get("vehicle_id") != geometry["ego_vehicle_id"]:
            raise ValueError("subject vehicle identity changed")
        motion.append({"frame": frame_row["frame"], "time_s": frame_row["time_s"],
                       "yaw_deg": ego.get("yaw_deg"), "turn_active": ego.get("turn_active")})
        if ego.get("turn_active") is True:
            if probe_target is not None:
                observed = _require_native(adapter.approach(frame), "approaching vehicle")
                if (observed.get("frame") != frame_row["frame"] or
                        observed.get("time_s") != frame_row["time_s"] or
                        observed.get("vehicle_id") != geometry["approach_vehicle_id"]):
                    raise ValueError("approaching vehicle frame or identity mismatch")
                ego_xyz, other_xyz = observed.get("ego_position"), observed.get("approach_position")
                if (not isinstance(ego_xyz, dict) or not isinstance(other_xyz, dict) or
                        any(not isinstance(pos.get(axis), (int, float)) or
                            not math.isfinite(pos[axis])
                            for pos in (ego_xyz, other_xyz) for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))):
                    raise ValueError("original approaching vehicle positions required")
                distance_m = math.dist([ego_xyz[a] for a in ("x", "y", "z")],
                                       [other_xyz[a] for a in ("x", "y", "z")])
                approach.append({"frame": frame_row["frame"], "time_s": frame_row["time_s"],
                                 "vehicle_id": observed["vehicle_id"],
                                 "ego_position": ego_xyz, "approach_position": other_xyz,
                                 "measured_distance_m": distance_m})
            for direction in DIRECTIONS:
                for station in STATIONS_M:
                    ray = _require_native(adapter.ray(frame, direction, station), "sight ray")
                    if (ray.get("frame") != frame_row["frame"] or
                            ray.get("time_s") != frame_row["time_s"] or
                            ray.get("direction") != direction or
                            ray.get("station_distance_m") != station):
                        raise ValueError("Native ray frame or station mismatch")
                    rays.append({key: ray.get(key) for key in
                                 ("frame", "time_s", "direction", "station_distance_m",
                                  "observer_height_m", "observer_lane_source",
                                  "target_vehicle_id", "body_point_clear", "terrain_hit_id")})
    if camera_recorder is not None:
        camera_recorder.close()
    packets = {
        "frame_map": {"frames": frames},
        "ego_motion": {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native", "samples": motion},
        "sight_rays": {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native", "samples": rays},
        "road_geometry": geometry,
    }
    if probe_target is not None:
        if not approach:
            raise ValueError("distance probe lacks original turn approach samples")
        target_m = probe_target * 0.3048
        first_m = approach[0]["measured_distance_m"]
        if abs(first_m - target_m) > 0.1:
            raise ValueError("original approach distance misses probe target")
        approach_packet = {"case_id": case_id,
                           "source_kind": "original_native", "samples": approach,
                           "probe_target_ft": probe_target,
                           "first_turn_distance_m": first_m,
                           "engineering_tolerance_m": 0.1,
                           "legal_visibility_judgment": "unresolved"}
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="native-sight-", dir=destination.parent) as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        inventory = {"case_id": case_id, "source_kind": "original_native", "sources": {}}
        if recording_id is not None:
            if (len(recording_id) != 64 or
                    any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in recording_id)):
                raise ValueError("exact recording ID digest required")
            inventory["recording_id"] = recording_id
        for name, packet in packets.items():
            path = root / f"{name}.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps(packet, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
            inventory["sources"][name] = {"path": path.name,
                                          "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        measured = measure(root, inventory, case_id)
        if camera_recorder is not None:
            inventory["camera_sources"] = {}
            for name, source_path in camera_recorder.files().items():
                target = root / (name + ".mkv")
                shutil.move(source_path, target)
                inventory["camera_sources"][name] = {
                    "path": target.name, "sha256": _file_sha256(target),
                    "source_kind": "original_native"}
        if probe_target is not None:
            approach_path = root / "approach_motion.json"
            approach_path.write_text(json.dumps(approach_packet, sort_keys=True,
                                                separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
            inventory["approach_probe"] = {"path": approach_path.name,
                                           "sha256": hashlib.sha256(approach_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        (root / "inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + "\n")
        root.rename(destination)
    if probe_target is not None:
        measured["approach_distance_probe"] = {
            "target_ft": probe_target, "first_turn_distance_m": first_m,
            "engineering_tolerance_m": 0.1,
            "legal_visibility_judgment": "unresolved"}
    return measured

"""Observed-heading phase marker for a source-gated Native reversal attempt.

This marks the physical heading-change interval for capture. A legal U-turn or
driver visibility determination requires separate original-source review.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math


def _delta_degrees(start: float, current: float) -> float:
    return abs((current - start + 180.0) % 360.0 - 180.0)


class HeadingReversalPhase:
    def __init__(self, start_threshold_deg: float = 2.0,
                 finish_threshold_deg: float = 165.0):
        if not 0 < start_threshold_deg < finish_threshold_deg < 180:
            raise ValueError("invalid observed heading thresholds")
        self.start_threshold_deg = start_threshold_deg
        self.finish_threshold_deg = finish_threshold_deg
        self.initial_yaw = None
        self.previous_frame = None
        self.started = False
        self.finished = False

    def __call__(self, frame: int, actor) -> bool:
        if type(frame) is not int or (self.previous_frame is not None and
                                      frame != self.previous_frame + 1):
            raise ValueError("observed turn phase needs consecutive Native frames")
        yaw = float(actor.get_transform().rotation.yaw)
        if not math.isfinite(yaw):
            raise ValueError("observed turn heading must be finite")
        self.previous_frame = frame
        if self.initial_yaw is None:
            self.initial_yaw = yaw
        if self.finished:
            return False
        delta = _delta_degrees(self.initial_yaw, yaw)
        if not self.started and delta >= self.start_threshold_deg:
            self.started = True
        if self.started and delta >= self.finish_threshold_deg:
            self.finished = True
        return self.started

"""Bounded Native route control for the reviewed reversal and approach actor.

Routes are supplied by a SHA-bound site packet. This controller follows them
without encoding a desired legal outcome or visibility label.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math


def _clamp(value, low, high):
    return max(low, min(high, value))


def _wrapped_radians(value):
    return (value + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi


class RouteFollower:
    def __init__(self, world_map, route: dict, location_factory,
                 control_factory):
        points = route.get("waypoints")
        speed = route.get("target_speed_mps")
        if (not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) < 3 or
                type(speed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(speed) or
                speed <= 0 or speed > 15):
            raise ValueError("reviewed route and bounded speed required")
        self.points = []
        for point in points:
            if (not isinstance(point, dict) or
                    any(type(point.get(axis)) not in (int, float) or
                        not math.isfinite(point[axis]) for axis in ("x", "y", "z")) or
                    type(point.get("road_id")) is not int or
                    type(point.get("lane_id")) is not int):
                raise ValueError("reviewed route waypoint incomplete")
            waypoint = world_map.get_waypoint(
                location_factory(point["x"], point["y"], point["z"]),
                project_to_road=False)
            if (waypoint is None or waypoint.road_id != point["road_id"] or
                    waypoint.lane_id != point["lane_id"]):
                raise ValueError("reviewed route leaves loaded road lane")
            self.points.append(point)
        if any(math.dist((a["x"], a["y"]), (b["x"], b["y"])) < 0.25
               for a, b in zip(self.points, self.points[1:])):
            raise ValueError("reviewed route has repeated or near-zero segment")
        self.target_speed = float(speed)
        self.control_factory = control_factory
        self.next_index = 1

    def apply(self, actor):
        transform = actor.get_transform()
        position = transform.location
        if self.next_index >= len(self.points):
            actor.apply_control(self.control_factory(throttle=0.0,
                                                     steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
            return "complete"
        target = self.points[self.next_index]
        distance = math.hypot(target["x"] - position.x,
                              target["y"] - position.y)
        if distance < 1.5:
            self.next_index += 1
            if self.next_index >= len(self.points):
                actor.apply_control(self.control_factory(throttle=0.0,
                                                         steer=0.0, brake=1.0))
                return "complete"
            target = self.points[self.next_index]
        heading = math.atan2(target["y"] - position.y,
                             target["x"] - position.x)
        yaw = math.radians(float(transform.rotation.yaw))
        speed = float(actor.get_velocity().length())
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (yaw, speed)) or speed < 0:
            raise ValueError("original actor motion is nonfinite")
        error = _wrapped_radians(heading - yaw)
        steer = _clamp(error / 0.8, -1.0, 1.0)
        throttle = _clamp((self.target_speed - speed) / 4.0, 0.0, 0.5)
        brake = _clamp((speed - self.target_speed) / 4.0, 0.0, 0.5)
        actor.apply_control(self.control_factory(throttle=throttle,
                                                 steer=steer, brake=brake))
        return "following"

"""Source-gated original C129731 reversal acquisition."""

def check():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    config = json.loads((root / 'config.json').read_text())
    raw = (root / 'case-plan.json').read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != config['plan_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Exact reversal case plan changed')
    plan = json.loads(raw)
    matching = [row for row in plan['cases'] if row['case_id'] == config['selected_case_id']]
    if len(matching) != 1 or config['assignment_id'] != plan['assignment_id']:
        raise ValueError('Exact reversal case absent')
    if (config['law_id'] != 'NRS-484B-407' or config['cell_id'] != 'C129731' or
            config['actor'] != 'motor_vehicle_driver' or
            config['selected_case_id'] != config['assignment_id'] + '__' + config['suffix']):
        raise ValueError('Exact reversal identity changed')
    from native_case_constructor import DISTANCE_TARGETS_FT
    if (config['target_first_turn_distance_ft'] != DISTANCE_TARGETS_FT[config['suffix']] or
            config['rate_hz'] != 20 or config['frame_count'] != 900 or
            config['duration_s'] != 45 or config['cameras'] !=
            ['overview', 'approach', 'reference_corner', 'driver_reference']):
        raise ValueError('Exact reversal distance or capture profile changed')
    return config['selected_case_id']


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--site')
    parser.add_argument('--site-sha256')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir')
    parser.add_argument('--carla-host', default='127.0.0.1')
    parser.add_argument('--carla-port', type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    case = check()
    if args.check:
        print('source-gated reversal bundle passed: ' + case)
        return
    if not args.site or not args.site_sha256 or not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError('Reviewed original mountain-road site and output required')
    output_root = os.environ.get('SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT')
    if not output_root or not Path(args.output_dir).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(output_root).resolve()):
        raise ValueError('Original attempt must be under configured output root')
    from carla_sight_adapter import load_reviewed_site
    load_reviewed_site(Path(args.site), args.site_sha256)
    from carla_sight_adapter import capture_original_carla
    from native_case_constructor import construct_case
    from world_restore import snapshot, restore
    import carla
    client = carla.Client(args.carla_host, args.carla_port)
    client.set_timeout(30.0)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    actors = ()
    try:
        world = client.get_world()
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        def transform(x, y, z, yaw):
            return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                                   carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw))
        actors = construct_case(world, world.get_blueprint_library(),
                                Path(args.site), args.site_sha256, case, transform)

            world, actors[0], actors[1], Path(args.site), args.site_sha256,
            carla.Location, case, Path(args.output_dir),
            control_factory=carla.VehicleControl)
        print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
    finally:
        try:
            for actor in reversed(actors):
                actor.destroy()
        finally:
            restore(client, saved)


if __name__ == '__main__':

"""Finalize original C129731 sight packets without assigning a legal verdict.

The source-shaped CPU tests exercise this entrypoint with generated packets.
Only a separately reviewed original Native acquisition may support delivery.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from sight_measurement import ASSIGNMENT, measure

INPUTS = ("inventory.json", "frame_map.json", "ego_motion.json",
          "sight_rays.json", "road_geometry.json")


def _sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def _recording_evidence(attempt: Path, report: dict, core_supplied: bool) -> list[dict]:
    """Write derived channel views while retaining the sealed source packets."""
    frame_map = json.loads((attempt / "frame_map.json").read_text())["frames"]
    motion = json.loads((attempt / "ego_motion.json").read_text())["samples"]
    rays = json.loads((attempt / "sight_rays.json").read_text())["samples"]
    if len(frame_map) != len(motion) or len(frame_map) != 900:
        raise ValueError("Original recording frame stream incomplete")
    grouped = {}
    for ray in rays:
        grouped.setdefault(ray["frame"], []).append(ray)
    times = {row["frame"]: row["time_s"] for row in frame_map}
    channels = {
        "ego_motion": [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row}
                       for row in motion],
        "sight_rays": [{"time_s": times[number], "value": grouped[number]}
                       for number in sorted(grouped)],
        "frame_join": [{"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row}
                       for row in frame_map],
        "original_camera_index": [
            {"time_s": row["time_s"],
             "value": {"video_frame": index, "native_frame": row["frame"],
                       "source_videos_verified": core_supplied}}
            for index, row in enumerate(frame_map)],
    }
    if not all(channels.values()):
        raise ValueError("Original recording channel missing")
    folder = attempt / "channels"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence = []
    for name, rows in channels.items():
        destination = folder / (name + ".jsonl")
        if destination.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite derived recording channel")
        destination.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":"),
                                          allow_nan=False) + "\n" for row in rows))
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": "source record",
                         "reference": str(destination.relative_to(attempt))})
    contexts = {
        "road_geometry": json.loads((attempt / "road_geometry.json").read_text()),
        "case_setup": {"selected_case_id": report["case_id"],
                       "source_inventory_sha256": _sha(attempt / "inventory.json")},
    }
    for name, value in contexts.items():
        destination = folder / (name + ".json")
        if destination.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite derived recording context")
        destination.write_text(json.dumps({name: value}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": "source record",
                         "reference": str(destination.relative_to(attempt))})
    return evidence


def _check_core_alignment(attempt: Path) -> bool:
    """Join any supplied Core timeline to every original sight frame and time."""
    mapping_path = attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"
    trace_path = attempt / "trace.jsonl"
    if not mapping_path.exists() and not trace_path.exists():
        return False
    if not mapping_path.is_file() or not trace_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Core trace and video frame map must be supplied together")
    sight = json.loads((attempt / "frame_map.json").read_text())["frames"]
    mapping = _jsonl(mapping_path)
    trace = _jsonl(trace_path)
    if not (len(sight) == len(mapping) == len(trace) == 900):
        raise ValueError("Core and sight frame counts differ")
    for index, (original, frame, motion) in enumerate(zip(sight, mapping, trace)):
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or
                frame.get("carla_frame") != original["frame"] or
                frame.get("time_s") != original["time_s"] or
                motion.get("frame") != original["frame"] or
                motion.get("time_s") != original["time_s"]):
            raise ValueError("Core and sight frame identity differs")
    return True


def measure_original_sight(attempt: Path, case_id: str) -> dict:
    """Measure observed reversal and two-direction rays from sealed packets."""
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    for name in INPUTS:
        if not (attempt / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    inventory = json.loads((attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__"):
        raise ValueError("Wrong selected reversal identity")
    for atom in ("frame_map", "ego_motion", "sight_rays", "road_geometry"):
        entry = inventory.get("sources", {}).get(atom, {})
        if entry.get("path") != atom + ".json":
            raise ValueError("Original packet path differs: " + atom)
    measured = measure(attempt, inventory, case_id)
    sources = {name: _sha(attempt / name) for name in INPUTS}
    values = {
        "heading_change_deg": measured["measured_heading_change_deg"],
        "turn_frame_count": measured["turn_frames"],
        "location_kind": measured["location_kind"],
        "opposing_blocked_ray_count": measured["blocked_ray_counts"]["ahead_opposing"],
        "following_blocked_ray_count": measured["blocked_ray_counts"]["behind_same_direction"],
        "two_direction_ray_count": measured["rays_checked"],
    }
    scope = ("diagnostic software fixture only; no Native or legal acceptance"
             if inventory.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True else
             "source-bound original sight measurement; legal judgment unresolved")
    return {"format": "c129731-selected-analysis-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "scope": scope,
            "analysis_complete": True, "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
            "limitations": ["A diagnostic fixture proves software wiring only",
                            "Original media and physical completion need independent review",
                            "Statutory driver visibility remains unresolved"],
            "measurements": {key: {"value": value,
                                   "method": "measure_original_sight",
                                   "sources": sources}
                             for key, value in values.items()},
            "original_sight": measured}


def build_canonical_result(attempt: Path, report: dict) -> dict:
    """Build the Native result shape; physical completion uses saved evidence."""
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result

    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("selected_case_id") != report["case_id"] or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-407" or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C129731" or
            config.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("Exact canonical reversal configuration changed")
    core_supplied = _check_core_alignment(attempt)
    if core_supplied:
        from native_camera_audit import audit as audit_native_cameras
        camera_audit = audit_native_cameras(attempt)
        if camera_audit.get("case_id") != report["case_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Original camera case differs from selected sight case")
        report["original_camera_audit"] = camera_audit
    values = report["measurements"]
    heading = values["heading_change_deg"]["value"]
    sources = values["heading_change_deg"]["sources"]
    checks = [{"target": "observed opposite-direction turn",
               "requested": True, "measured": heading >= 150,
               "method": "original frame-joined subject heading change",
               "tolerance": "150 degrees engineering observation minimum",
               "matched": heading >= 150, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
               "cause_evidence": sources}]
    suffix = config["selected_case_id"].removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if suffix != "distance_reference":
        probe = attempt / "approach_motion.json"
        if not probe.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: approach_motion.json")
        inventory = json.loads((attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
        reference = inventory.get("approach_probe", {})
        if (reference.get("path") != probe.name or
                reference.get("sha256") != _sha(probe)):
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe hash differs")
        packet = json.loads(probe.read_text())
        if packet.get("case_id") != report["case_id"] or packet.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe identity changed")
        target_ft = config["target_first_turn_distance_ft"]
        measured_m = packet.get("first_turn_distance_m")
        if (packet.get("probe_target_ft") != target_ft or
                type(measured_m) not in (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("Original approach probe target changed")
        target_m = target_ft * .3048
        matched = abs(measured_m - target_m) <= .1
        checks.append({"target": "first reversal approach distance",
                       "requested": target_m, "measured": measured_m,
                       "method": "original frame-joined vehicle positions",
                       "tolerance": .1, "matched": matched,
                       "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                       "cause_evidence": {"approach_motion.json": _sha(probe)}})
    description = construction["recording_description"]
    if not isinstance(description.get("channels"), list) or len(description["channels"]) != 4:
        raise ValueError("Four declared Native recording channels required")
    evidence = _recording_evidence(attempt, report, core_supplied)
    result = {"case_id": report["case_id"],
              "measured_values": {key: item["value"] for key, item in values.items()},
              "target_checks": checks, "setup_confirmed": False,
              "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved original evidence assessment pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in
                                   ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": description,
              "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {}}
    result = physical_result(attempt, result)
    validate_result(result)
    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--finalize", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite analysis output")
    case = args.case
    if case is None:
        case = json.loads((args.attempt / "config.json").read_text())["selected_case_id"]
    report = measure_original_sight(args.attempt, case)
    if args.finalize or (args.attempt / "construction.json").is_file():
        result_path = args.attempt / "result.json"
        if result_path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Refusing to overwrite canonical result")
        result = build_canonical_result(args.attempt, report)
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        report["physical_checks"] = result["physical_checks"]
        report["realized_observables"] = result["realized_observables"]
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Source-bound mountain-road reversal and two-direction 500-foot sight audit.

The operational 1.4 m lane-observer and nine-body-point convention is an
engineering measurement. It does not decide statutory driver visibility.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C129731__NRS-484B-407__motor_vehicle_driver"
LIMIT_M = 152.4
STATIONS_M = (10.0, 50.0, 100.0, 150.0, 152.4)
DIRECTIONS = ("ahead_opposing", "behind_same_direction")
SOURCES = ("frame_map", "ego_motion", "sight_rays", "road_geometry")


def _source(root: Path, entry: dict):
    rel = Path(entry["path"])
    if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts:
        raise ValueError("source path escapes original attempt")
    path = (root / rel).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("original sight source missing")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != entry["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("original sight source hash mismatch")
    return json.loads(raw)


def measure(root: Path, inventory: dict, case_id: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(root)
    if not case_id.startswith(ASSIGNMENT + "__") or inventory.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("exact reversal case mismatch")
    if inventory.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
        raise ValueError("original Native source required")
    sources = inventory.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(sources, dict) or set(sources) != set(SOURCES):
        raise ValueError("complete sight source inventory required")
    packets = {name: _source(root, sources[name]) for name in SOURCES}
    geometry = packets["road_geometry"]
    if (geometry.get("source_kind") != "original_native_geometry" or
            geometry.get("highway_source") is None or
            geometry.get("location_kind") not in
            ("curve", "approach_to_crest", "near_crest")):
        raise ValueError("original highway curve or crest geometry missing")
    frames = packets["frame_map"].get("frames")
    if not isinstance(frames, list) or len(frames) < 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame history missing")
    first = frames[0].get("frame")
    if type(first) is not int or [r.get("frame") for r in frames] != list(range(first, first + len(frames))):
        raise ValueError("original frame sequence not consecutive")
    times = [r.get("time_s") for r in frames]
    if any(type(t) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(t) for t in times) or any(
            abs(b - a - .05) > .005 for a, b in zip(times, times[1:])):
        raise ValueError("original frame clock not 20 Hz")
    ego = packets["ego_motion"]
    if ego.get("case_id") != case_id or ego.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
        raise ValueError("original ego motion identity mismatch")
    motion = ego.get("samples")
    if not isinstance(motion, list) or len(motion) != len(frames):
        raise ValueError("original ego motion incomplete")
    for row, frame in zip(motion, frames):
        if row.get("frame") != frame["frame"] or row.get("time_s") != frame["time_s"]:
            raise ValueError("ego frame/time join mismatch")
        if (type(row.get("yaw_deg")) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isfinite(row["yaw_deg"]) or type(row.get("turn_active")) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("original heading or turn phase missing")
    active = [r for r in motion if r["turn_active"]]
    if len(active) < 2:
        raise ValueError("original reversal phase missing")
    heading_change = abs((active[-1]["yaw_deg"] - active[0]["yaw_deg"] + 180) % 360 - 180)
    if heading_change < 150:
        raise ValueError("measured vehicle did not reverse direction")
    rays = packets["sight_rays"]
    if rays.get("case_id") != case_id or rays.get("source_kind") != "original_native":
        raise ValueError("original ray source identity mismatch")
    rows = rays.get("samples")
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("original ray history absent")
    expected = {(frame["frame"], direction, station)
                for frame in active for direction in DIRECTIONS for station in STATIONS_M}
    turn_times = {frame["frame"]: frame["time_s"] for frame in active}
    seen = set()
    blocked = {direction: 0 for direction in DIRECTIONS}
    for row in rows:
        key = (row.get("frame"), row.get("direction"), row.get("station_distance_m"))
        if key not in expected or key in seen:
            raise ValueError("ray frame/direction/station outside original turn")
        if row.get("time_s") != turn_times[row["frame"]]:
            raise ValueError("sight ray original frame/time join mismatch")
        seen.add(key)
        points = row.get("body_point_clear")
        if (type(row.get("observer_height_m")) not in (int, float) or
                abs(row["observer_height_m"] - 1.4) > .001 or
                not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) != 9 or
                any(type(value) is not bool for value in points) or
                row.get("target_vehicle_id") != geometry.get("ego_vehicle_id") or
                not row.get("observer_lane_source")):
            raise ValueError("original nine-point sight ray provenance incomplete")
        if not any(points):
            if not row.get("terrain_hit_id"):
                raise ValueError("blocked sight ray lacks actual terrain occluder")
            blocked[row["direction"]] += 1
    if seen != expected:
        raise ValueError("both approach directions lack complete 500-foot sight coverage")
    return {"format": "c129731-original-two-direction-sight-v1",
            "case_id": case_id, "source_sha256": {name: sources[name]["sha256"] for name in SOURCES},
            "original_frames": len(frames), "turn_frames": len(active),
            "location_kind": geometry["location_kind"],
            "measured_heading_change_deg": heading_change,
            "observer_height_m": 1.4, "station_distances_m": list(STATIONS_M),
            "statutory_distance_m": LIMIT_M, "blocked_ray_counts": blocked,
            "rays_checked": len(expected),
            "driver_visibility_judgment": "unresolved"}


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite original sight measurement")
    inventory = json.loads((args.attempt / "inventory.json").read_text())
    result = measure(args.attempt, inventory, args.case)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
